message: Blocked by guard (bare-cp-rm): bare cp and rm are aliased and ask for confirmation; use `command cp -f SOURCE TARGET` and `unlink PATH`

Blocked by guard (pkill): pkill and pgrep -f are not allowed because they can stop other agents' processes; list the processes with `ps -axo pid,command | grep '[p]attern'`, then run `kill PID...` on exactly the PIDs listed
